falsification_rule_binding.source: D1 proposal falsification_rule (sha-cited in section1 citations)
falsification_rule_binding.statement: KILL if, at I on the identical bookable grid, restricted leg set and window under the identical frozen cost treatment, ANY designated KILLER control (the price-only persistence shadow, the bare release-clock shadow, or the stale-release placebo) earns a strictly greater after-cost per-decision edge than the ANCHOR arm. The price-only shadow matching the anchor means 'persist until a trigger' is price momentum in disguise (momentum_63s class); the release-clock shadow matching the anchor means the geometry adds nothing over the release weekday; the stale-release placebo matching the anchor means the release-aligned official flow carries nothing.
